gap: Space between the blocks of the section. 0px on every section but one: the groups inside set the spacing.
section_width: Keep **Page**, as on every section: the rails are drawn at the page width.
section_height: Keep **Auto**, as on every section: the section is as tall as its content.
background_media: Leave on **None**. Tangent sections stay on the plain white page.
background_color: Leave empty. Colored bands aren't part of the Tangent design.
toggle_overlay: Leave off. Only for a section with a background photo or video, which the site doesn't use.
border: Leave on **None**. The Tangent lines come from **Rails** and **Top border across the page**.
border_radius: Leave at 0px: the Tangent design keeps square corners.
ts_frame: The thin vertical lines down both sides of the page. Keep **Rails, no inner padding**, as on every section; **Rails with inner padding** adds side space inside the lines.
ts_rule: A thin line across the top of the section, so sections are divided by a line. On for almost every section.
ts_pattern: Faint blue dots under the blocks. **Dot lattice**: behind a centered heading; **Dot lattice at the end**: beside left-aligned text; the bottom-corner choices: statement and closing rows.
padding-block-start: Most sections keep 0px and leave the spacing to the groups inside; about 30 keep 96px.
padding-block-end: Most sections keep 0px and leave the spacing to the groups inside.
